title: 巴基斯坦财长：美伊协议是自豪时刻
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Can you give us a sense of some of the challenges that your colleagues faced and bringing these two parties together?
segments.zh: 能谈谈您的同事们促成双方走到一起时面临了哪些挑战吗？

segments.en: Yeah, so, Paul, it's indeed a very different day as you just mentioned.
segments.zh: 是的，保罗，正如你刚才所说，今天确实是非常不同的一天。

segments.en: The way I looked at it is a proud moment for Pakistan and a great moment for global economy.
segments.zh: 在我看来，这是巴基斯坦的骄傲时刻，也是全球经济的伟大时刻。

segments.en: So, as you have been mentioning earlier in your program, Pakistan's leadership, Prime Minister Shabar Shriksh and Field Marshal Sayyid Asimani,
segments.zh: 正如你节目早些时候提到的，巴基斯坦领导人总理沙巴兹·谢里夫和陆军参谋长阿西姆·穆尼尔将军，

segments.en: have been acknowledged and continue to be acknowledged around the world for really two reasons.
segments.zh: 因两个原因持续受到全球认可。

segments.en: One is that trust and confidence repose in both of them by the US administration and the Iranian leadership.
segments.zh: 一是美国政府和伊朗领导层对他们两人的信任和信心。

segments.en: And that has indeed played a critical role in terms of the mediation efforts on which they have been earnest,
segments.zh: 这在他们认真、坚持且不懈的调解努力中发挥了关键作用。

segments.en: they have been persistent and they have been underlenting in today we see at least the first part now going up to the signing on Friday has gone through the finishing line.
segments.zh: 今天，至少第一部分——周五的签署——已经冲过终点线。

segments.en: Now, of course, we have not seen the text yet of the MOU, we're expecting to receive that on Friday. Have you seen it and can you at least give us a sense of what's in it if you have?
segments.zh: 当然，我们还没看到谅解备忘录文本，预计周五收到。您看过了吗？如果看过，能否透露一下内容？

segments.en: Well, I think we'll have to wait till Friday till the actual signing takes place.
segments.zh: 我想我们得等到周五正式签署。
